mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods with sustained HOUST increases, or the correlation between HOUST growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO declines and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods with RSAFS outpacing GDPC1, or the interaction effect between RSAFS and GDPC1 growth rates on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of GDP (GDPC1) exceeds the growth rate of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL), it indicates real economic growth outpacing inflation, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > CPIAUCSL YoY growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods with GDPC1 outpacing CPIAUCSL, or the interaction effect between GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL growth rates on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
